name: io.github.MoonEyes/google-ecommerce-mcp
title: Google E-commerce (GA4, Search Console, Merchant Center, Ads)
description: Multi-client read and controlled write (off by default): GA4, GSC, Merchant, GTM, ad platforms.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_SITE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Search Console property, sc-domain:example.com or https://www.example.com/

environmentVariables.name: GEM_CLIENT
environmentVariables.description: Pin this server process to one client of the client registry (clients.json)

environmentVariables.name: GEM_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow writing at all (off by default; each client and platform must also be enabled)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Store the OAuth token in this file instead of the OS keyring
